Served items (estimated):
- Muesli, about 60 g: roughly 220 kcal.
- Milk bottle, about 250 ml of semi-skimmed milk: about 120 kcal.
- Latte, about 300 ml: about 130 kcal.
- Total served: about 470 kcal.

What was eaten:
- Milk: the bottle went from roughly 60% full to about 40% full, so about 80 ml was poured onto the cereal.
- Muesli: nearly all of it was eaten. About 5 g remains in the bowl with some milk, roughly 30 kcal left over.
- Latte: the cup still looks fairly full, maybe 70% remaining. That leaves about 90 kcal, so about 40 kcal was drunk.
- Milk left in the bottle: about 140 ml, roughly 65 kcal.

Totals:
- Leftover: 30 + 90 + 65 = about 185 kcal.
- Eaten: 470 − 185 = about 285 kcal.

Macronutrients eaten:
- Muesli (55 g, about 200 kcal): 6 g protein, 36 g carbs, 3.5 g fat.
- Milk on the cereal (80 ml, minus some left in the bowl; about 60 ml net, roughly 30 kcal): 2 g protein, 3 g carbs, 1 g fat.
- Latte drunk (about 40 kcal): 2.5 g protein, 3.5 g carbs, 1.5 g fat.
- Total: 10.5 g protein, 42.5 g carbs, 6 g fat. That works out to about 265 kcal, which I rounded up to 275 in the answer.
